data_fields.name: journal_index
data_fields.donor_constant: int per quest line; -1 means no journal entry

data_fields.name: response_disposition
data_fields.donor_constant: int threshold in response data, compared to NPC derived disposition (range not read)

data_fields.name: select_comparison
data_fields.donor_constant: six operators: eq, ne, gt, ge, lt, le

data_fields.name: idle_slot_roll
data_fields.donor_constant: each idle slot rolls 0 to 100 and wins if roll <= its chance and highest so far

best_idea: Quest progress is a forward-only journal index plus a finished or restart marker carried by each dialogue line, with each line counted once, so a quest is one small record that lines can move forward but never backward.
decision_why: Take the index, markers and per-line dedupe; scope the restart rule to a catalogue quest id instead of the display name, and reject duplicate indexes at zone load; no clock schedule exists in this donor, so routines come from the OpenGothic note.
acceptance: A server test: one quest with lines at index 1, index 2 (finished) and a restart line; hearing index 2 twice adds one entry and keeps index 2, a late index 1 line does not lower it, the restart line clears finished, and a zone with two index-2 lines fails to load.
